version: as published with LiTraj (repository pushed_at 2025-06-05; paper npj Comput. Mater. 11, 131, 2025)
paper_reference: Dembitskiy et al., "Benchmarking machine learning models for predicting lithium ion migration", npj Computational Materials 11, 131 (2025)
record_unit: one whole-crystal structure per Materials Project material_id, with 1D/2D/3D percolation barriers
available_structure_fields: full periodic crystal structure embedded per record in extended-XYZ (BVEL13k_train.xyz, BVEL13k_val.xyz, BVEL13k_test.xyz)
lattice/cell, fractional coordinates, species (as read via ASE/pymatgen)

target_fields.E_1D_x_nsites / E_2D_x_nsites / E_3D_x_n: barrier scaled by number of sites, present in per-frame atoms.info but not used as a primary target

official_split_column: _split (train/val/test), embedded in the index CSV and consistent with per-split .xyz files
known_missing_censored_disordered_data: No missing target values (0/12807 for E_1D/E_2D/E_3D). No censored values -- BVSE-computed barriers are always exact numeric estimates, not experimental inequality-censored measurements. Disorder/fractional occupancy of the underlying Materials Project structures was not separately re-verified in this phase; occupancy must be inspected per-structure at feature-engineering time in Phase 1, not assumed absent.
notes: Percolation barriers are computed with the empirical BVSE/BVEL method (not DFT-NEB); per RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md this is microscopic transport supervision, not equivalent to DFT-NEB migration barriers or experimental conductivity. nebBVSE122k (bvse_hops) and nebDFT2k (dft_neb) material_id sets are exact subsets of this dataset's material_id set (see reports/results/leakage/pretraining_id_overlap.json) -- all three pretraining datasets share the same underlying Materials Project screening universe. The larger MPLiTrj/MPLiTrj_subsample sibling datasets (929,066 / 118,024 configurations, 16GB/2.1GB) were deliberately NOT downloaded: they are force/energy/stress supervision for training universal interatomic potentials, not one of the four dataset roles defined in DATA_CONTRACT.md, and are out of scope for this project unless a future planning change adds that role.
